recent_articles.title: Indigenous Vayu Astra-1 completes high-altitude trials in Uttarakhand, Pokhran - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nibe Limited**, a Pune-based defense technology firm, successfully completed no-cost, no-commitment demonstrations of its indigenous loitering munition system ‘Vayu Astra-1’ for the **Indian Army**. The demonstrations were conducted in April at Pokhran in Rajasthan and Joshimath (Malari) in Uttarakhand.  The anti-personnel variant of Vayu Astra-1 demonstrated a 10-kg warhead strike at a range of 100 km with a CEP of less than one meter, achieving an abort attack and reattack capability during the trials.

recent_articles.title: Centre tells Supreme Court no new hydel projects should come up in upper Ganga - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Union government** has submitted to the Supreme Court that no new hydroelectric projects should be permitted in the upper reaches of the Ganga in Uttarakhand. The Ministries of Environment, Jal Shakti and Power presented a single affidavit stating this position, citing concerns about cumulative impact on the ecosystem and seismic fragility. This decision comes after years of expert recommendations and court orders regarding dam development's potential to exacerbate flooding risks.  The matter is scheduled for hearing on May 20th.

recent_articles.title: Uttarakhand files first FIR on allegations of nikah halala under Uniform Civil Code - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Uttarakhand Police** have filed a chargesheet in an alleged nikah halala case, invoking provisions of the Uniform Civil Code (UCC) alongside dowry and Muslim marriage laws. The FIR, registered on April 4th, 2026, was initially based on allegations of dowry harassment, cruelty, and violations of Muslim marriage laws.  The investigation later included examination of nikah halala allegations, leading to the addition of UCC-linked provisions in the chargesheet. **Nine** accused were named in the final report, with notices issued under the BNSS provisions.

recent_articles.title: ECI set to roll out phase III of SIR in ‘coming days’ to cover 22 States, UTs - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Election Commission of India (ECI)** is set to begin phase three of its Special Intensive Revision (SIR) voter list process in the coming days, covering nearly 40 crore electors across 17 states and five UTs.  This follows completion of SIR in 10 states and three UTs previously, which has successfully removed over 60 lakh deceased voters from the rolls. The ECI had initially delayed the rollout due to Assembly elections in several states but is now proceeding with the revision process.  The exercise aims to ensure accurate voter lists for upcoming elections.

recent_articles.title: Congress slams Modi Government over women’s safety citing NCRB data - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** party leaders, including **Mallikarjun Kharge**, criticized the **Narendra Modi Government** for its handling of women's safety and rising crime rates.  Kharge cited data from the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) showing a significant increase in crimes against women, children, Dalits, Adivasis, and cybercrime during the past decade. He accused the government of using "Beti Bachao" and "Nari Vandan" as mere slogans while failing to address these issues effectively. **Alka Lamba**, president of the All India Mahila Congress, echoed these concerns, alleging that the BJP was shielding perpetrators instead of ensuring justice for victims.

recent_articles.title: Census enumerators ID can be verified through QR code - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Lalit Jain**, Director of Census Operations (DCO), **Haryana**, has introduced QR code-enabled identity cards for enumerators to address concerns about authenticity.  Jain explained that residents can verify the legitimacy of enumerators by scanning the codes on their ID cards. The first phase of the digital census, which began on April 1, aims to cover over 30 lakh households across India. Residents are legally obligated to answer Census-related questions, and while there have been no cases of FIRs for non-response, local authorities will be involved in encouraging participation.  The second phase of the census, focusing on caste enumeration, is scheduled for February 2027.

recent_articles.title: Gurugram gated societies not letting in enumerators; FIRs recommended against enumerators obstructing Census work - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Haryana** administration has recommended an FIR against two government school staff for alleged negligence in Census-related work and obstruction of duties.  **Gurugram Municipal Corporation Joint Commissioner Punit Kumar** stated that enumerators have been denied entry into several highrise apartment buildings, prompting him to write to RWAs to ensure their access. **Registrar General of India Mritunjay Kumar Narayan** flagged off awareness vans across Delhi for the ongoing Census 2027 public outreach campaign.  The first phase of the Census began on April 1 and will conclude by September 30, involving around 30 lakh enumerators.

recent_articles.title: PM Modi on West Bengal election result: ‘Lotus’ is blooming from Gangotri to Gangasagar - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** praised the outcomes of the elections in four States and a Union Territory as a triumph of democracy and the Constitution, attributing the BJP's success to voters seeking stability and development amidst global turmoil. He highlighted women's crucial role in building a developed India, accusing the Congress and Samajwadi Party of blocking women's reservation in the Lok Sabha.  **Modi** expressed confidence that the BJP-led NDA would continue its efforts to serve people and work ceaselessly for a developed India.

recent_articles.title: Nepal lodges protest against India over long-running border dispute | Border Disputes News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nepal**'s Ministry of Foreign Affairs lodged a protest against **India** after the country announced the resumption of a religious pilgrimage through the Lipulekh Pass, which is claimed by **Nepal** based on a 1816 treaty.  **India** maintains that the pass has been used for pilgrimages since 1954 and disputes **Nepal's** territorial claims. The dispute reignited after **India** agreed with **China** to resume the pilgrimage, which was suspended in 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

recent_articles.title: Independent journalism punished, compliance rewarded under current regime, says Kharge - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge** criticized the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** government for its alleged attempts to suppress press freedom in India.  He stated that since 2014, India's position in the World Press Freedom Index has declined and the BJP is seeking to tighten its control over social media to silence dissent. **Kharge** also accused the government of weaponizing legal frameworks to intimidate journalists and noted a sharp rise in arrests and imprisonments of journalists. He highlighted several high-profile cases, including those of journalists murdered while reporting on corruption.  He urged for upholding democratic norms by those in power.

recent_articles.title: India rejects Nepal’s objection to Kailash Manasarovar Yatra via Lipulekh Pass - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **India** responded to **Nepal's** objection to the Kailash Manasarovar Yatra passing through Lipulekh Pass, stating that such territorial claims are "untenable." The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) clarified that Lipulekh Pass has been a long-standing route for the pilgrimage since 1954 and that India remains open to dialogue with **Nepal** on all bilateral issues.

recent_articles.title: Uttarakhand youth dies by suicide after alleging police harassment in video on social media - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Pankaj Kumar**, a 20-year-old from Retpur village, was found hanging from a bridge in Satpuli, Uttarakhand on Saturday.  He had posted a video online accusing **local police** of harassment after seizing his motorcycle. **Police** identified the deceased and informed his family. The incident was reported to authorities by a local resident who alerted them through an emergency call.

recent_articles.title: Census 2027: Around 82 lakh households have opted for self enumeration as field visits begin in 5 states - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Union government** announced that over 82 lakh households have utilized the self-enumeration facility during the initial Houselisting and Housing Operations (HLO) phase of Census 2027. The exercise, which commenced on May 1st in several states including Andhra Pradesh, Haryana, Chandigarh, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, and Rajasthan, aims to collect data about household facilities and demographics.  The HLO will continue until May 30th, with trained enumerators visiting each house for verification.

recent_articles.title: Kailash Mansarovar Yatra 2026: dates, routes, application process and all you need to know - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA)** announced the schedule for this year's Kailash Manasarovar Yatra, which will take place between June and August.  A computer-generated, random selection process will be used to select 20 batches of 50 tourists each, with one batch traveling through Uttarakhand via Lipulekh Pass and another through Sikkim via Nathu La Pass.

recent_articles.title: Hindustan Zinc dividend alert! Last date to buy shares for Rs 11 dividend, do you own? - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Hindustan Zinc**, a subsidiary of **Vedanta**, announced a 550% interim dividend on its shares, totaling Rs 4,648 crore.  Shareholders who purchased shares before April 30th will be eligible for the dividend, which will be credited to their demat accounts by tomorrow. This latest dividend follows a consistent tradition of rewarding shareholders and brings the company's total dividend payouts since 2001 to 44. The announcement coincided with **Hindustan Zinc**'s Q4 earnings report, which showed a 68% year-on-year increase in net profit to Rs 5,033 crore for the January-March quarter of FY26.
